direction: backward/output-to-reference; add offset to output UV to sample reference image; X right, Y down
layout: frames[k] row-major nodes y then x; each node interleaved dx,dy signed integers in tenths of one UHD pixel
excluded: HUD, eye blink, blue eye effect, fingertip glow, bottom hologram. In these regions, neighbor-derived subject motion is interpolated and fades when unsupported.
